title: County Supply Co. — Farm, Fence & Hardware — Marchfield
description: The last farm store in Verity County, selling real t-posts and real chainsaw chain through an e-commerce platform that writes its own product descriptions and will not let the owner delete the fake reviews.

products.name: Studded T-Post, 6 ft, 1.25 lb/ft, Green with White Top
products.blurb:
Six foot, 1.25 pound per foot, painted green with a white top. Anchor plate is welded, not clipped.

Priced each. Bundle of 5 is $37.50 at the counter in Marchfield, which is cheaper than five, and we cannot make the website do that.

[b]Twenty or more is a freight order.[/b] Under twenty ships parcel and arrives bent about one time in ten, which is the shipper's doing and not ours. We will replace a bent post. We will not pretend it did not happen.
bullets: 6 ft, 1.25 lb/ft, studded face, welded anchor plate
Takes standard clips — we sell those by the bag, 25 ct, $4.10
In stock at 214 Stanhope St, Marchfield. Counter pickup usually 20 minutes
SELLER NOTE: we do not control the parcel carrier and neither does the tracking page

reviews.title: Left at the end of a quarter mile lane
reviews.body:
Ordered twelve. The driver put them at the mailbox, which is a quarter mile from the house, on a Friday, in the rain.

The posts are fine. The posts have always been fine. I have bought posts from this store since the Coyne Flats one was open. I am rating the part of this that went wrong.

reviews.title: Excellent product, fast delivery
reviews.body: Item arrived quickly and was exactly as described. The packaging was excellent and the seller communicated well throughout. Quality is excellent for the price and I would not hesitate to order again from this store.

reviews.title: Excellent product, fast delivery
reviews.body: Item arrived quickly and was exactly as described. The packaging was excellent and the seller communicated well throughout. Quality is excellent for the price and I would not hesitate to order again from this store.

reviews.title: Picked them up myself
reviews.body: Drove in, they were on the rack by the west door, loaded them myself in eight minutes. That is the whole review.

products.name: Barbed Wire, 12.5 ga, 4-Point, 5 in Spacing, 80 Rod Spool (1,320 ft)
products.blurb:
Class 3 galvanized, 12.5 gauge, four point, barbs on five inch centers. Eighty rod spool, 1,320 feet, about 82 pounds on the pallet scale.

This ships freight or you pick it up. It will not go parcel. Two people have tried.
bullets: 80 rod / 1,320 ft, Class 3 galv
Ships LTL freight, curbside, liftgate is $45 extra and you want it

reviews.title: Freight took eleven days for forty miles
reviews.body:
Spool is good wire. Eleven days from Marchfield to Halsey, which is forty minutes in a truck.

The freight company called once, at 6:40 in the morning, and when I called back it went to a menu with no option that was my situation.

reviews.title: Fine. Order the liftgate.
reviews.body: I did not order the liftgate. Eighty-two pounds coming off the back of a trailer at chest height taught me something.

reviews.title: SAME SPOOL 60% CHEAPER
reviews.body: Do not pay this price!! Identical 80 rod spool $44 with free shipping at [url=synth://farmwire-liquidation.deal-barn.top/]farmwire-liquidation[/url] while stock lasts!!

Ten line wires, 47 inches tall, six inch stay spacing, 330 foot roll. Class 3 galvanized.

Roll will not fit in a half ton bed with the tailgate up
Ag exemption: bring the form to the counter, the website cannot do it

reviews.title: Curbside means curbside
reviews.body:
It is in the ditch. It has been in the ditch since Tuesday. My neighbour is bringing a tractor Saturday.

The fence is good fence. I have no complaint about the fence.

reviews.title: Excellent product, fast delivery
reviews.body: Item arrived quickly and was exactly as described. The packaging was excellent and the seller communicated well throughout. Quality is excellent for the price and I would not hesitate to order again from this store.

reviews.title: For a garden, this is more fence than you need
reviews.body:
I bought a roll to keep deer out of about forty feet of raspberries, on advice, and I have 290 feet of it left standing in my garage.

This is not the store's fault. Nobody told me to buy 330 feet. I did that. If you are doing a garden, the counter will cut you woven wire off the reel, and I did not know that until afterwards.

products.name: Ridgeline 110V Fence Charger, 2.0 Joule, 25 Mile, 3-Year Warranty
products.blurb:
Two joule stored, rated 25 miles of clean wire, which nobody has. Figure a quarter of that with weeds on it.

Plug-in, not solar. If you have power at the fence, buy this one. Three year warranty and we handle the warranty here rather than making you mail it somewhere.

Threads about grounding on [url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/]boards.gridfall.net[/url] go back twenty years and are mostly still correct: three rods, eight feet, ten feet apart.
bullets: 2.0 joule stored, 1.4 joule delivered
110V plug-in, 6 ft cord
Needs three 8 ft ground rods. We sell them, $16.40 each
Warranty handled at the counter, not by mail

reviews.title: Works. Noisy on the radio, but so is everything out here.
reviews.body:
Fence is hot the whole run, 1,900 feet, two strands, some weeds.

I am out past the quarry cut on 62 and the AM radio in the barn ticks along with the charger. It also picks up the numbers, and it picked those up before I owned a charger, so do not write to me about it.

reviews.title: Second one, third ground rod
reviews.body: Bought my first one in 2019 and it took a hit in a storm two winters back. This is the replacement. The difference between a charger that works and one that does not is almost always the ground rods, and I did not believe that either.

reviews.title: Excellent product, fast delivery

reviews.title: 0.04 joule
reviews.body:
Put a meter on it. It reads 0.04 joule. Fifty miles would be twelve to fifteen.

It will tickle a hand. It will not turn a steer. I did not buy this from County Supply, I bought it from a stranger on County Supply's website, and it took me a while to understand that those are two different things.

reviews.title: This is not their product
reviews.body:
For the people asking on the boards: the store did not choose this listing. The platform bolted a marketplace onto the site in March and this came with it.

Dee has asked. I have read the ticket responses. They are the same response.

Semi-chisel, .325 pitch, .063 gauge, 72 drive links. This is a 20 inch bar chain on most saws that use .325.

We loop chain off the reel at the counter for anything odd, $19.00 plus the reel foot.
bullets: .325 pitch / .063 gauge / 72 DL
Semi-chisel, low kickback

reviews.title: Ordered Thursday, on the counter Friday

reviews.body:

Chain is correct and sharp. Nine days though. I could have driven to Marchfield and back eleven times.

reviews.title: Excellent product, fast delivery

products.name: Bar & Chain Oil, 1 Gallon, Tacky Formula, All Season
products.blurb:
One gallon. Tacky enough to stay on the bar and not sling off into the leaves, which is the entire job.

In winter it thickens. Everyone's does. Keep it inside the night before.
bullets: 1 gallon, all-season tacky formula
Case of 4 is $52.00 at the counter

Called the store, they had another one on the truck the next day and did not ask for the empty back. Four stars because the oil is fine and the jug is not.

Tank is a tank. No complaints. Skipped the freight entirely and saved $85.

Customer sentiment for this product is broadly positive. Residents in the Verity County area report consistent availability and competitive pricing, and the community has responded well to the store's pickup option. This summary was generated from 73 reviews and may contain inaccuracies.

reviews.title: Sizing, and the paragraph at the top of this page
reviews.body:
The generator is fine. 5,500 running is enough for a furnace blower, a fridge, a well pump and lights if you do not ask for them all at once. A half horse submersible is about 1,000 running and 2,400 on start. A gas furnace blower is 600. A 4,500 watt water heater element is not going on this and you should stop planning for it now.

On the paragraph at the top of the page:

Substation No. 3 went at 4:52 a.m. on 11 June 2003. Not 2004. 4,100 customers out, some for five days. The state commission summary in November 2003 is two pages and gives the cause as insulation degradation consistent with age. It does not say lightning. Verity Valley has never released the internal report.

No one died. Two of the Gridfall volunteers were treated at County General for smoke and released the same afternoon.

I have sent this to the store and they told me they cannot edit that box. I believe them. I am putting it here instead.

reviews.body: Peace of mind for my family at last. Started on the second pull and ran our whole house during the storm last month. Every household in the area should own one of these given the history. Excellent value and fast delivery.

It took three of us and a come-along. The generator has been excellent since. The day it arrived was not.
